moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is holding strong at UK No.1 for a record-breaking 20th week, chasing a 21st.

angles.name: Chart domination
angles.copy: 20 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are absolutely dominating the UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. Can anyone stop them?

angles.name: Record breaker
angles.copy: History made! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean just keeps going, now 20 weeks at the top. The longest-running UK No.1 by a British act ever!

moments.title: Ariana Grande's triple threat on the charts
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande has three tracks making waves in the UK Singles Chart this week: 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' is at No.3, 'Petal' at No.4, and 'Kiss Me' debuts at No.15.

angles.name: Ariana's Chart Attack
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is having a HUGE week on the charts! Three tracks in the Top 15 – 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' (No.3), 'Petal' (No.4), and 'Kiss Me' (No.15). Which is your favourite?

angles.name: New Ariana hits
angles.copy: New Ariana is here and making an impact! 'Petal' is Top 5 and 'Kiss Me' is a brand new entry. Her album is definitely getting people talking.

angles.name: Football's Back

angles.name: Opening Weekend
